findings.location: Paragraph beginning “And at midnight Paul and Silas…”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “milango ikafunguka kwa kishindo” with “milango ikafunguka ghafla” to convey that the doors flew open without adding a banging sound.

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Pure and holy music is a blessing…”
findings.source_quote: It helps me stay calm, be encouraged, and keep my mind on the Lord.
findings.suggested_fix: Change “Hunisaidia kutulia, kutia moyo, na kuweka akili yangu kwa Bwana” to “Hunisaidia kutulia, kutiwa moyo, na kuweka akili yangu kwa Bwana” so “be encouraged” remains passive.
findings.translation_quote: Hunisaidia kutulia, kutia moyo, na kuweka akili yangu kwa Bwana
